title: AI Moga桂冰：借力汽车供应链，量产成本能降多少？

segments.en: yeah because just I mentioned I think in too many scenes we can see the together I think the first one from the technology side because I think today is the intelligent robot car is like a big robot
segments.zh: 正如我提到的，在很多场景中我们都能看到协同。首先是技术层面，今天的智能汽车就像一个大机器人。

segments.en: because I think in the car system they have very stronger supply chain because I think in Olga we think maybe we are the first robot company we are trying to use all the supply chain use the car industry supply chain

segments.en: because the car industry supply chain generally say they are very power they have big revenue they have also invest in a huge money in the R&D side I think in all comparing with the other maybe robot company
segments.zh: 汽车供应链通常实力雄厚，营收规模大，在研发上投入巨大。相比之下，其他机器人公司可能还处于起步阶段。

segments.en: I think they are in the beginning stage they are not going to say the big volumes and also how to control quality and some things I think in this order since it's where we the challenger in the future
segments.zh: 它们还没有形成大规模量产，质量控制等方面也面临挑战。这正是我们未来要突破的方向。

segments.en: if really the robot come to the big volume and also the cost because I think today the robots the quantity is small so I think maybe if in the future they want to become the big volumes should surely the cost the price is also where we are big challenger for the futures
segments.zh: 如果机器人要实现大规模量产，成本控制是关键。目前机器人数量少，未来要上量，价格是重大挑战。

segments.en: and also from the after sales the sales networks I think in from the car industry also could be shared too many things together which the robot because the car industry also can provide too many different working
segments.zh: 在售后和销售网络方面，汽车行业也可以共享很多资源。汽车产业还能为机器人提供多种工作场景。
